summary: 20-ft wooden L-4 lookout built 1934 in Gifford Pinchot NF, Lewis County WA; removed or destroyed in the 1950s. A foundation was found in 2015 on West Fork Timber land.

notes_for_editor: Built date 1934 agrees across four sources; the end date is only the 1950s and the sources disagree on removed versus destroyed. Elevation: the record's 738.5 m matches the register's 2,423 ft (739 m), but Willhite gives 2,040 ft, which we did not use. Location: the record's point is the register's own coordinates. The west_us_lookouts point (46.6279, -122.2465) is about half a kilometre away; Willhite placed the site by map comparison, so neither point is confirmed on the ground. Ownership: the register says the Forest Service administers the site, but Willhite says the route crosses West Fork Timber land and does not say who owns the site. The 1942-43 activation appears only on the washingtonlookouts list. No photo URLs were available in the pages read, so no photos were added. No correction proposed.
